questions.question: What does Asaph do in his day of trouble in Psalm 77?
options: Cries aloud to God and seeks the Lord, his hand stretched out
Bows down very low and offers up his sacrifice to God
Sings aloud to God and gives him thanks with a truly glad heart
Waits in deep silence and lifts up his eyes to the hills
questions.answer: Cries aloud to God and seeks the Lord, his hand stretched out

questions.question: What anguished questions does he ask?
options: Have my sins shut me out from His presence? Will He count my guilt against me forever?
Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he in anger shut up his compassion?
Why do the nations rage so fiercely? Why do the peoples plot in vain?
How long, O LORD, will this go on? Will you hide your face from me forever?
questions.answer: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he in anger shut up his compassion?

questions.question: Asaph resolves to remember the deeds of the LORD and ponder his work.
Your way, O God, is holy. What god is great like our _____?
